**Goal:** Save the original Stata file for Colombia, 2010 GEIH, GPWG, master V02, harmonization V09. Step 06 reads this file without another download.

**On this Mac:** Mount the approved `pip` share in Finder and run the cell. It looks in `/Volumes/pip/pipsystem` and opens the saved survey. For this read-only check, no environment setting, R restart, or DLW connection is needed. If the share is mounted elsewhere, `PIP_SURVEY_ROOT` can point to its `pipsystem` folder. A normal render does not run the cell.

**First download only:** If the file is missing, use an R session with DLW access and `TMPDIR` set to the network survey folder **before R starts**. This keeps download staging and the cache off the Mac's local disk.

```{r save-one-survey}
save_one_survey <- function() {
  root <- Sys.getenv("PIP_SURVEY_ROOT")
  if (!nzchar(root)) root <- "/Volumes/pip/pipsystem"
  if (!dir.exists(root)) {
    stop("Survey folder not found: ", root, ". Mount the pip share in Finder.",
         call. = FALSE)
  }
  root <- normalizePath(root, mustWork = TRUE)
  mounts <- system2("/sbin/mount", c("-t", "smbfs"), stdout = TRUE)
  mount_paths <- sub("^.* on (.*) \\(.*$", "\\1", mounts)
  if (!dirname(root) %in% mount_paths) {
    stop("The survey folder is not on a mounted SMB share. Check the mount.",
         call. = FALSE)
  }

  filename <- "COL_2010_GEIH_V02_M_V09_A_GMD_GPWG.dta"
  target <- file.path(root, filename)
  check_table <- function(path) {
    sample <- haven::read_dta(path, n_max = 1L)
    stopifnot(nrow(sample) == 1L, ncol(sample) > 0L)
  }

  if (file.exists(target)) {
    check_table(target)
    return("PASS: existing network file opened; no download or overwrite")
  }

  if (!startsWith(normalizePath(tempdir()), paste0(root, "/"))) {
    stop("Survey file not found. For a new download, start R with TMPDIR=",
         root, ". No download was attempted.", call. = FALSE)
  }
  withr::local_envvar(c(R_USER_CACHE_DIR = tempdir(), XDG_CACHE_HOME = tempdir()))
  staged <- tempfile("incoming-", tmpdir = tempdir(), fileext = ".dta")
  receipt <- dlw::dlw_download_file(
    country_code = "COL", filename = filename, server = "GMD", year = 2010L,
    vermast = "V02", veralt = "V09", path = staged, overwrite = FALSE
  )
  stopifnot(!is.data.frame(receipt), is.list(receipt),
            identical(tolower(receipt$filename), tolower(filename)),
            file.exists(staged))
  check_table(staged)

  # Publish the checked file on the same volume; never replace another copy.
  status <- system2("/bin/mv", c("-n", shQuote(staged), shQuote(target)))
  stopifnot(status == 0L, !file.exists(staged))
  check_table(target)
  return("PASS: saved and reopened the network file")
}
cat(save_one_survey(), "\n")
```

**Check:** At least one row and one column can be read from the saved file. This is a file-read check, not survey validation. A failure leaves Step 06 unverified; it does not trigger a different download or a local fallback.

**Step 06 input:** `COL_2010_GEIH_V02_M_V09_A_GMD_GPWG.dta` in the network survey folder. Treat this original file as read-only.

**Recorded Mac check (2026-11-25): PASS.** The first run saved and reopened the network file. A fresh R session opened it again without a download or overwrite. Formatting and survey validation were not run.
